SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT O.*, F.PROCESSSTATUS FOLDERSTATUS, F.MONITORPOINTNAME, F.MONITORPOINTNO, F.SAMPLEUSERNAME, P.PROJNO, P.PROJNAME, P.TESTORGNAME, P.ENTRUSTORGNAME, P.BIZCATEGORYCODE, F.FOLDERNO, C.ORDERSTATUS FROM T_EMC_ORDER O LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER F ON F.ID = O.FOLDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT P ON P.ID = O.PROJID LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.ID AS ORDERID, CASE WHEN INSTR( WM_CONCAT ( CASE B.RESULTSTATUS WHEN 'Done' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END ), '0' ) > 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS ORDERSTATUS FROM T_EMC_ORDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT B ON A.ID = B.ORDERID GROUP BY A.ID) C ON O.ID = C.ORDERID) T
ORDER BY
T.SAMPLEBEGINDATE DESC, T.ORDERNO DESC, T.ID DESC
